tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi sa bcad snang byed sgron me gzhung dang bcas pa bzhugs so//

༄༅// "$ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zab cing spros pa nyer zhi ba// 'phags gsum smin byed rgyal ba kun/ skyed mdzad rten cing 'brel 'byung ba// rgyal yum khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'di la gnyis ste lots+tsha bas smos pa'i mtshan/ gzhung dngos so// dang po lots+tsha bas smos pa'i mtshan ni/ rgya gar skad du zhes pa'o// gnyis pa gzhung dngos la gsum/ klad kyi don dang/ gzhung dang/ 'jug gi don bsdus rnam grangs gzhan bstan pa'o// dang po klad kyi don la gnyis/ mkhyen pa gsum gyis 'phags bzhi bskyed pa'i sgo nas mchod par brjod pa dang/ dgos 'brel dgod pa'o// dang po mkhyen pa gsum gyis 'phags bzhi bskyed pa'i sgo nas mchod par brjod pa ni/ nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams kun shes nyid kyis nyer zhir khrid mdzad gang yin dang// 'gro la phan par byed rnams lam shes nyid kyis 'jig rten don sgrub mdzad pa gang// gang dang yang dag ldan pas thub rnams rnam pa kun ldan sna tshogs 'di gsungs pa// nyan thos byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bcas sangs rgyas kyi ni yum de la phyag 'tshal// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa dgos 'brel dgod pa la bzhi/ brjod bya dang/ 'brel pa dang/ dgos pa dang/ nying dgos so// dang po brjod bya ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam// zhes so// gnyis pa 'brel ba ni/ ston pas 'di las bshad pa gang// gzhan gyis myong ba ma yin te// chos spyod bcu yi bdag nyid kyis// mdo don dran pa la bzhag nas// zhes so// gsum pa dgos pa ni/ blo dang ldan pas mthong 'gyur phyir// zhes so// bzhi pa nying dgos ni/ bde blag tu ni rtogs pa zhes// bya ba rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gnyis ste/ mdor bstan lus rnam bzhag dang/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po mdor bstan lus rnam gzhag la gnyis/ mdor bstan skabs brgyad dang/

rgyas bshad don bdun cu'i ming bstan pa'o// dang po mdor bstan skabs brgyad ni/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni// dngos po brgyad kyis yang dag bshad// rnam kun mkhyen nyid lam shes nyid// de nas thams cad shes pa nyid// rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa dang// rtse mor phyin dang mthar gyis pa// skad cig gcig mngon rdzogs byang chub// chos kyi sku dang de rnam brgyad// ces so// gnyis pa rgyas bshad don bdun cu'i ming bstan pa la brgyad de/ rnam mkhyen/ lam shes/ gzhi shes/ rnam kun/ rtse mo/ mthar gyis pa/ skad cig ma/ chos sku rnam dbye dang bcas pa'o// dang po rnam mkhyen ni/ sems bskyed pa dang gdams ngag dang// nges 'byed yan lag rnam bzhi dang// sgrub pa yi ni rten gyur pa// chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dang// dmigs pa dag dang ched dang ni// go cha 'jug pa'i bya ba dang// tshogs ni nges par 'byung bcas rnams// thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid// ces so// gnyis pa lam shes ni/ mog mog por byed la sogs dang// slob ma bse ru'i lam gang dang// 'di dang gzhan pa'i yon tan gyis// phan yon che ba mthong ba'i lam// byed pa dang ni mos pa dang// bstod dang bkur dang bsngags pa dang// bsngo dang rjes su yid rang ba// yid la byed pa bla med dag /sgrub dang shin tu dag pa zhes// bya ba 'di ni sgom pa'i lam// byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rnams kyi// lam shes nyid ni de 'drar bshad// ces so// gsum pa gzhi shes ni/ shes pas srid la mi gnas shing// snying rjes zhi la mi gnas dang// thabs ma yin pas ring ba dang// thabs kyis ring ba ma yin nyid// mi mthun gnyen po'i phyogs dag dang// sbyor dang de yi mnyam nyid dang// nyan thos la sogs mthong ba'i lam// de 'dra kun shes nyid du 'dod// ces so// bzhi pa rnam kun ni/ rnam pa sbyor bar bcas rnams dang// yon tan skyon ni mtshan nyid bcas// thar dang nges 'byed cha mthun dang/

slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs// srid dang zhi ba mnyam nyid dang// zhing dag bla na med pa ni// rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa ste// 'di ni thabs mkhas bcas pa yin// ces so// lnga pa rtse mo ni/ de yi rtag dang rnam 'phel dang// brtan dang sems kun gnas pa dang// mthong zhes bya dang bsgom pa zhes// bya ba'i lam ni so so la// rnam par rtog pa rnam bzhi yi// gnyen po rnam pa bzhi dang ni// bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin// log par bsgrub dang bcas pa ni// rtse mo'i mngon rtogs// zhes so// drug pa mthar gyis pa ni/ mthar gyis pa// rnam gsum rnam bcu// zhes so// bdun pa skad cig ma ni/ skad cig ma// gcig gis mngon rdzogs byang chub pa// mtshan nyid kyi ni rnam pa bzhi// zhes so// brgyad pa chos sku rnam dbye dang bcas pa ni// ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs bcas dang// de bzhin gzhan pa sprul pa ni// chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa// rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag brjod// ces so// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum/ yul mkhyen pa gsum/ thabs sbyor ba bzhi/ 'bras bu chos sku'o// dang po yul mkhyen gsum la gsum ste/ 'bras bu rnam mkhyen bshad pa/ lam gyi gzhi lam shes/ lam gyi yan lag gol ba dang bcas pa'i gzhi shes bshad pa'o// dang po rnam mkhyen la bdun te/ sems bskyed pa dang/ gdam ngag dang/ nges 'byed sbyor lam dang/ bsgrub pa'i rten rigs 'gal dang bcas pa dang/ bsgrub pa'i dmigs pa bcu gcig /ched du bya ba/ bsgrub pa'i ngo bo'o// dang po sems bskyed pa la gsum ste/ sems bskyed kyi ngo bo/ mdo dang sbyar ba/ sa 'tshams dbye ba'o// dang po sems bskyed kyi ngo bo ni/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir// yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod// ces so// gnyis pa mdo dang sbyar ba ni/ de dang de ni mdo bzhin du// bsdus dang rgyas pa'i sgo nas brjod// ces so// gsum pa sa 'tshams dbye ba ni/

de yang sa gser zla ba me// gter dang rin chen 'byung gnas mtsho// rdo rje ri sman bshes gnyen dang// yid bzhin nor bu nyi ma glu// rgyal po mdzod dang lam po che// bzhon pa bkod ma'i chu dang ni// sgra snyan chu bo sprin rnams kyis// rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis so// zhes so// gnyis pa gdam ngag la brgyad de/ bsgrub pa'i ngo bo/ dmigs pa'i yul rten/ mi mthun phyogs spang ba'i rgyu gsum/ dring mi 'jog pa spyan lnga/ khyad par can dang 'brel ba'i rgyu mngon shes/ rnam par dag pa mthong bsgom la gdams pa/ khyad par du dge 'dun bstan pa'o// dang po bsgrub pa'i ngo bo ni/ bsgrub dang/ zhes so// gnyis pa dmigs pa'i yul ni/ bden pa rnams dang ni// zhes so// gsum pa rten ni/ sangs rgyas la sogs dkon mchog gsum// zhes so// bzhi pa mi mthun phyogs spang ba'i rgyu gsum ni/ ma zhen yongs su mi ngal dang// lam ni yongs su 'dzin pa dang// zhes so// lnga pa dring mi 'jog pa spyan lnga ni/ spyan lnga dang ni/ zhes so// drug pa khyad par can dang 'brel ba'i rgyu mngon shes ni/ mngon shes kyi// yon tan drug dang/ zhes so// bdun pa rnam par dag pa mthong bsgom la gdams pa ni/ mthong lam dang// sgom zhes bya la gdams ngag ni// bcu yi bdag nyid shes par bya// zhes so// brgyad pa khyad par du dge 'dun bstan pa ni/ dbang po rtul dang rnon po dag /dad dang mthong thob rigs nas rigs// bar chad gcig bar skyes nas dang// byed dang byed min 'og min 'gro// 'phar gsum srid rtse'i mthar thug 'gro// gzugs kyi chags bcom mthong ba yi// chos la zhi lus mngon sum byed// bse ru dang ni nyi shu'o// zhes so// gsum pa nges 'byed sbyor lam la brgyad de/ nges 'byed mdor bstan pa dang/ drod kyi dmigs rnam/ rtse mo'i/ bzod pa'i/ chos mchog gi dmigs rnam che 'bring chung ngu gsum gsum dang/

mdo rgyas kyis gzung rtog dang/ 'dzin rtog bstan pa dang/ yongs 'dzin la gdams pa'o// dang po nges 'byed mdor bstan pa ni/ dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang// rgyu dang yongs su 'dzin pa yis// byang chub sems dpa'i skyob pa yi// drod sogs bdag nyid ci bzhin du// rnam rtog bzhi po ldan bsten pa// chung dang 'bring dang chen po rnams// nyan thos bse ru lta bu dang// bcas pa dag las khyad par 'phags// zhes so// gnyis pa drod kyi dmigs rnam che 'bring chung gsum ni/ dmigs pa mi rtag la sogs pa// bden pa'i rten can de yi ni// rnam pa mngon zhen la sogs 'gog /theg pa gsum char 'thob pa'i rgyu// gzugs sogs 'du 'god gnas bral dang// gnas dang btags dang brjod du med// ces so// gsum pa rtse mo'i dmigs rnams chung 'bring che gsum ni/ gzugs sogs mi gnas de dag ni// de yi ngo bor rang bzhin med// de dag gcig gi rang bzhin gcig /de mi rtag sogs par mi gnas// de rnams de yi ngo bos stong// de dag gcig gi rang bzhin gcig /chos rnams mi 'dzin gang yin dang// de dag mtshan mar mi mthong phyir// shes rab kyis ni yongs rtog pa// thams cad dmigs su med par ro// zhes so// bzhi pa bzod pa'i dmigs rnam chung 'bring che gsum ni/ gzugs sogs ngo bo nyid med nyid// de med pa nyid ngo bo nyid// de dag skye med nges 'byung med// dag dang de dag mtshan ma med// de yi mtshan mar mi rten pas// mos min 'du shes med pa yin// zhes so// lnga pa chos mchog gi dmigs rnam chung 'bring che gsum ni/ ting 'dzin de yi byed pa nyid// lung ston pa dang rlom pa zad// gsum po phan tshun ngo bo gcig /ting 'dzin rnam par mi rtog pa// de ltar nges 'byed cha mthun ni// chung dang 'bring dang chen po yin// zhes so// drug pa mdo rgyas kyis gzung rtog bstan pa ni/

gzhi dang de yi gnyen po yis// gzung bar rtog pa rnam pa gnyis// rmongs dang phung sogs bye brag gis// de ni so sor rnam pa dgu// zhes so// bdun pa mdo rgyas kyis 'dzin rtog bstan pa ni/ rdzas dang btags pa'i rten can gyis// 'dzin pa'ang rnam pa gnyis su 'dod// rang dbang bdag sogs ngo bo dang// phung sogs rten las de bzhin no// zhes so// brgyad pa yongs 'dzin bstan pa ni/ sems mi 'gong ba nyid las sogs// ngo bo nyid med sogs ston byed// de yi mi mthun phyogs bor ba// rnam pa kun tu yongs 'dzin yin// zhes so/ bzhi pa bsgrub pa'i rten rigs 'gal dang bcas pa ni/ rtog pa yi ni chos drug dang// gnyen po dang ni spong ba dang// de dag yongs su gtugs pa dang// shes rab snying brtser bcas pa dang// slob ma thun mong min nyid dang// gzhan gyi don gyi go rim dang// ye shes rtsol ba mi mnga' bar// 'jug pa'i rten la rigs shes bya// zhes dang/ chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir// rigs ni tha dad rung ma yin// rten pa'i chos kyi bye brag gis// de yi dbye ba yongs su brjod// ces so// lnga pa bsgrub pa'i dmigs pa bcu gcig ni/ dmigs pa chos rnams thams cad de// de yang dge la sogs pa yin// 'jig rten pa yi rtogs pa dang// gang dag 'jig rten 'das 'dod dang// zag bcas zag pa med chos dang// gang dag 'dus byas 'dus ma byas// slob ma thun mong chos rnams dang// gang dag thub pa'i thun mong min// zhes so// drug pa bsgrub pa'i ched du bya ba ni/ sems can kun mchog nyid sems dang// spong dang rtogs dang gsum po la// chen po gsum gyi rang 'byung gi /ched du bya ba 'di shes bya// zhes so// bdun pa bsgrub pa'i ngo bo la drug ste/ go cha brtson 'grus kyi bsgrub pa dang/ 'jug pa rnam pa dgu dang/ tshogs bcu bdun bsgrub pa dang/ bye brag du sa'i tshogs dang/

gnyen po rnam pa brgyad kyi tshogs dang/ nges 'byung bsgrub pa brgyad do// dang po go cha brtson 'grus kyi bsgrub pa ni/ de dag so sor sbyin la sogs// rnam pa drug tu bsdus pa yis// go cha'i bsgrub pa gang yin de// drug tshan drug gi ji bzhin bshad// ces so// gnyis pa 'jug pa rnam pa dgu ni/ bsam gtan gzugs med sbyin sogs dang// lam dang byams la sogs pa dang// dmigs pa med dang ldan pa dang// 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa dang// ched du bya dang mngon shes drug /rnam kun mkhyen pa'i tshul la ni// 'jug pa'i sgrub pa theg chen la// 'dzeg pa yin par shes par bya// zhes so// gsum pa tshogs bsgrub bcu bdun ni// brtse dang sbyin la sogs pa drug /zhi gnas lhag mthong bcas pa dang// zung du 'brel pa'i lam gang dang// thabs la mkhas pa gang yin dang// ye shes dang ni bsod nams dang// lam dang gzungs dang sa bcu dang// gnyen po tshogs kyi sgrub pa yi// rim pa yin par shes par bya// zhes so// bzhi pa sa'i tshogs bye brag du bshad pa la bcu ste// sa dang po'i yongs su sbyang ba bcu dang/ gnyis pa'i brgyad dang/ gsum pa'i lnga dang/ bzhi pa'i bcu dang/ lnga pa'i bcu dang/ drug pa'i bcu gnyis dang/ bdun pa'i nyi shu spang ba dang/ sbyang ba dang/ brgyad pa'i brgyad dang/ dgu pa'i bcu gnyis dang bcu pa bstan pa'o// dang po sa dang po'i yongs sbyong bcu ni/ yongs su sbyong ba rnam bcu yis// sa ni dang po 'thob 'gyur te// bsam dang phan pa'i dngos nyid dang// sems can rnams la sems mnyam nyid// gtong dang bshes gnyen sten pa dang// dam chos dmigs pa tshol ba dang// rtag tu nges 'byung sems nyid dang// sangs rgyas skur 'dod dga' ba dang// chos ston pa dang bden pa yi// tshig ni bcu pa yin par 'dod// 'di dag rang bzhin mi dmigs pas// yongs su sbyong bar shes par bya// zhes so// gnyis pa'i brgyad ni/

tshul khrims byas pa gzo dang bzod// rab tu dga' dang snying brtse che// bkur sti bla ma la gus nyan// brgyad pa sbyin la sogs la brtson// zhes so// gsum pa'i lnga ni/ thos pas mi ngoms nyid dang ni// zang zing med par chos sbyin dang// sangs rgyas zhing kun sbyong ba dang// 'khor ba yongs su mi skyo dang// ngo tsha khrel yod ces bya ba// rlom med bdag nyid de rnams lnga// zhes so// bzhi pa'i bcu ni/ nags gnas 'dod chung chog shes dang// sbyangs pa yang dag sdom sten dang// bslab pa yongs su mi gtong dang// 'dod pa rnams la smod pa dang// mya ngan 'das dang bdog kun gtong// mi zhum pa dang lta ba med// ces so// lnga pa'i bcu ni/ 'dris dang khyim la 'khren pa dang// 'du 'dzir gyur pa'i gnas dang ni// bdag bstod gzhan la brnyas pa dang// mi dge'i las kyi lam bcu dang// rlom pas khengs dang phyin ci log /blo ngan dang ni nyon mongs bzod// bcu po 'di ni rnam spangs na// sa lnga pa ni yang dag 'thob// ces so// drug pa'i bcu gnyis ni/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus// bsam gtan shes rab rab rdzogs pas// slob ma dang ni bse ru la// dga' dang skrag pa'i sems spangs pa// bslangs na mi zhum bdog pa kun// btang yang mi dga' med pa dang// dbul yang slong ba mi spong ba'i// sa ni drug pa yang dag 'thob// ces so// bdun pa'i spang bya nyi shu ni/ bdag dang sems can 'dzin pa dang// srog dang gang zag chad rtag dang// mtshan ma rgyu dang phung po dang/ khams dang skye mched dag dang ni// khams gsum po la gnas dang chags// sems ni kun tu zhum pa dang// dkon mchog gsum dang tshul khrims la// der lta ba yi mngon zhen dang// stong pa nyid la rtsod pa dang// de dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa ni// nyi shu gang la rnam chad pa// de yis sa ni bdun pa 'thob// ces so// sbyong ba nyi shu ni/ rnam thar sgo gsum shes pa dang// 'khor gsum rnam par dag nyid dang// snying rje dang ni rlom med dang// chos mnyam nyid dang tshul gcig shes// mi skye ba dang bzod shes dang// chos rnams rnam pa gcig tu ston// rtog pa kun tu 'joms pa dang// 'du shes lta dang nyon mongs spong// zhi gnas nges par sems pa dang// lhag mthong la ni mkhas pa dang// sems dul ba dang thams cad la// thogs pa med pa'i ye shes dang// chags pa'i sa min gar 'dod par// zhing gzhan du ni mnyam 'gro dang// kun tu bdag gi ngo bo ni// ston pa nyid dang nyi shu'o// zhes so// brgyad pa'i brgyad ni/

sems can kun yid shes pa dang// mngon par shes pas rtse ba dang// sangs rgyas zhing bzang sgrub pa dang// yongs su brtag phyir sangs rgyas bsten// dbang po shes dang rgyal ba yi// zhing sbyong sgyu ma ltar gnas dang// bsam bzhin srid pa len pa dang// las ni rnam pa 'di brgyad bshad// ces so// dgu pa'i bcu gnyis ni// smon lam dag ni mtha' yas dang// lha la sogs pa'i skad shes dang// spobs pa chu bo lta bu dang// mnga' du 'jug pa mchog dang ni// rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang dang// 'khor dang skye ba dag dang ni// nges 'byung byang chub shing rnams dang// yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yin// sa bcu pa bstan pa ni/ sa dgu 'das nas ye shes ni// gang gis sangs rgyas sar gnas pa// de ni byang chub sems dpa'i sa// bcu pa yin par shes par bya// zhes so// lnga pa gnyen po'i tshogs ni/ mthong dang goms pa'i lam dag la// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog rnams// nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i phyir// gnyen po rnam pa brgyad ces bya// zhes so// drug pa nges 'byung sgrub pa ni/ ched du bya dang mnyam nyid dang// sems can don dang 'bad med dang// mtha' las 'das par nges 'byung dang// thob pa'i mtshan nyid nges 'byung dang// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid dang// lam gyi yul can nges 'byung ste// rnam pa brgyad kyi bdag nyid 'di// nges 'byung bsgrub pa yin shes bya// zhes so// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces bya ba las/ skabs dang po'o/// /gnyis pa lam gyi gzhi lam shes la gnyis/ lam shes skye ba'i yan lag dang/ dngos so// dang po lam shes skye ba'i yan lag ni/ lha rnams rung bar bya ba'i phyir// 'od kyis mog mog por mdzad dang// yul nges pa dang khyab pa dang// rang bzhin dang ni de yi las// zhes so// gnyis pa lam shes dngos la gsum/ nyas thos dang/ rang rgyal dang/

byang chub sems dpa'o// dang po nyan thos kyi lam la lnga/ lam gyi rang bzhin/ drod/ rtse mo/ bzod pa/ chos mchog go /dang po lam gyi rang bzhin ni/ lam shes nyid kyi tshul la ni// 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dag gi /rnam pa mi dmigs sgo nas ni// nyan thos lam 'di shes par bya// zhes so// gnyis pa drod ni/ 'phags pa nyan thos lam la ni// gzugs la sogs pa stong pa'i phyir// stong pa nyid rnams dbyer med pas// dro ba// zhes so/ gsum pa rtse mo ni/ de dag mi dmigs pas// rtse mor gyur pa dag tu 'dod// ces so/ bzhi pa bzod pa ni/ de la rtag la sogs tshul gyis// gnas pa bkag pas bzod pa rnams// zhes so// lnga pa chos mchog ni/ sa bcu dag las brtsams nas ni// mi gnas rgyas par bstan pa yis// chos kyi mchog tu 'gyur bshad de// ci phyir zhe na sangs rgyas kyis// mkhyen nas chos rnams ma gzigs phyir// zhes so// rang rgyal la bzhi/ nyan thos dang khyad par/ sgra med par chos ston tshul/ lam gyi ngo bo/ sbyor lam nges 'byed bstan pa'o// dang po nyan thos dang khyad par bstan pa ni/ rang byung bdag nyid rtogs pa'i phyir// gzhan gyis bstan yang mi dgos la// bse ru lta bu'i ye shes ni// zab pa nyid du mngon par brjod// ces so/ gnyis pa sgra med par chos ston tshul ni/ gang gang don ni gang gang la// ji lta ji ltar nyan 'dod pa// de de la don de dang de// sgra med kyang de de ltar snang// zhes so// gsum pa lam gyi ngo bo ni/ gzung don rtog pa spong phyir dang// 'dzin pa mi spong phyir dang ni// rten gyis bse ru lta bu'i lam// yang dag bsdus par shes par bya// zhes so// bzhi pa sbyor lam nges 'byed bstan pa ni/ btags pa'i chos nyid mi 'gal bar// ston pa'i rnam pa dror gyur pa// rtse mor gyur pa gzugs la sogs// 'grib pa med las sogs pas phye// nang stong nyid la sogs pa yis// gzugs sogs mi 'dzin phyir bzod pa// gzugs sogs skye ba med sogs kyi// rnam pa can ni chos kyi mchog

/ces so// gsum pa byang chub sems dpa'i lam la gnyis/ mthong lam khyad par can dang/ bsgom lam mo/ dang po mthong lam la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang// rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po mdor bstan ni/ bden dang bden la bzod pa dang// shes pa'i skad cig rnam bzhi yis// lam shes nyid la mthong ba'i lam// phan yon bcas pa 'di bshad do// zhes so// gnyis pa rgyas bshad ni/ de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas dag /phan tshun rten pa rten med phyir// rnam grangs khas mi len pa dang// chen po tshad ma med bcas dang// tshad med pa dang mtha' med dang// der gnas gzugs la sogs pa la// sangs rgyas nyid du nges 'dzin dang// blang med dor ba med sogs dang// byams la sogs dang stong nyid dang// sangs rgyas nyid ni 'thob pa dang// rnam par byang kun yongs bsdus dang// nyam nga ba dang nad kun sel// mya ngan 'das 'dzin zhi nyid dang// sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsrung la sogs// srog mi gcod pa la sogs pa// rnam pa kun mkhyen tshul la ni// bdag nyid gnas te sems can dag /'god dang sbyin pa la sogs pa// rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba// lam shes nyid kyi skad cig ma// zhes so// gnyis pa bsgom lam la gnyis/ bsgom lam gyi byed pa dang/ byed pa can gyi bsgom lam mo/ dang po bsgom lam gyi byed pa ni/ kun nas zhi dang thams cad la// bdud dang nyon mongs las rgyal dang// gnod pas rdzi ba med nyid dang// byang chub dang ni rten mchod nyid// ces so// gnyis pa byed pa can gyi bsgom lam la gnyis/ zag bcas dang zag med do// dang po zag bcas bsgom lam la bzhi ste/ mos pa bsgom pa dang de la bstod bkur bsngags pa dang/ bsngo ba dang/ yid rang ba'o// dang po mos pa bsgom pa ni/ mos pa rang gi don dang ni// rang gzhan don dang gzhan don dang// rnam gsum shes bya de yang ni// chung dang 'bring dang chen po ste// so sor rnam pa gsum du 'dod// chung ngu'i chung sogs dbye ba yis// de yang rnam gsum de ltar na// rnam pa nyi shu bdun du 'dod// ces so// gnyis pa de la bstod bkur bsngags pa ni/

shes rab pha rol phyin pa la// mos pa'i gnas skabs rnams la ni// dgu tshan gsum gyis bstod pa dang// bkur ba dang ni bsngags par 'dod// ces so// gsum pa bsngo ba la drug /ngo bo dang/ rnam pa dang/ mtshan nyid dang/ thabs dang 'brel ba dang/ mi mthun sogs spang ba dang/ dbye ba phan yon dang bcas pa'o// dang po ngo bo ni/ yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can// de yi byed pa mchog yin no// zhes so// gnyis pa rnam pa ni/ de ni dmigs med rnam pa can// zhes so// gsum pa mtshan nyid ni/ phyin ci ma log mtshan nyid do// zhes so// bzhi pa thabs dang 'brel pa ni/ dben dang sangs rgyas bsod nams tshogs// rang bzhin dran pa'i spyod yul can// thabs bcas mtshan ma med pa dang// sangs rgyas rjes su yid rang dang// zhes so// lnga pa mi mthun phyogs spang ba ni/ khams gsum gtogs pa ma yin dang// zhes so// drug pa dbye ba phan yon dang bcas pa ni/ chung dang 'bring dang chen po yi// bsngo ba gzhan ni rnam gsum po// bsod nams che 'byung bdag nyid do// zhes so// bzhi pa rjes su yid rang ba ni/ thabs dang mi dmigs pa dag gis// dge ba'i rtsa la yid rang ba// rjes su yid rang yid byed pa// bsgom pa yin par 'dir brjod do// zhes so// gnyis pa zag med bsgom lam la gsum/ bsgom lam dngos bsgrub pa/ de la mos mi mos kyi rgyu/ rnam dag go /dang po sgom lam dngos bsgrub pa ni/ de yi ngo bo nyid mchog nyid// kun la mngon par 'du mi byed// chos rnams dmigs su med par ni// gtod par byed pa don chen nyid// ces so// gnyis pa de la mos mi mos kyi rgyu ni/ sangs rgyas bsten dang sbyin sogs dang// thabs la mkhas pa gang yin pa// 'di la mos pa'i rgyu dag yin// chos kyis phongs pa'i rgyu dag ni// bdud kyi thibs kyis non pa dang// zab mo'i chos la ma mos dang// phung po la sogs mngon zhen dang// sdig pa'i grogs pos yongs zin pa'o// zhes so// gsum pa rnam dag la bzhi ste/

rnam dag spyir bstan/ khyad par bstan pa/ theg dman gyi shin tu dag pa dang/ theg chen gyi shin tu dag pa'o// dang po rnam dag spyir bstan pa ni/ 'bras bu dag pa gzugs la sogs// dag pa nyid de gang gi phyir/ de gnyis tha dad ma yin zhing// gcad du med pas dag par brjod// ces so// gnyis pa khyad par bstan pa ni/ nyon mongs shes bya lam gsum gyi// nyams phyir slob ma bse ru dang// rgyal sras rnams kyi dag pa ste// sangs rgyas rnam kun shin tu ba// zhes so// gsum pa theg dman gyi dag pa ni/ sa dgu la ni chen po yi// chen po la sogs dri ma yi// gnyen po chung ngu'i chung ngu la// sogs pa'i lam ni dag pa yin// ces so// bzhi pa theg chen gyi shin tu dag pa ni/ de la klan ka spangs ba yis// lam ni 'jal dang gzhal bya dag /mnyam pa nyid kyis khams gsum gyi// gnyen po nyid du 'dod pa yin// zhes skabs gnyis pa'o/// /gsum pa lam gyi yan lag gol sa dang bcas pa gzhi shes la gnyis te/ dngos dang/ mkhyen pa gsum gyi bsdu ba'o// dang po dngos la gsum ste/ gzhi shes kyi rang bzhin sbyor ba/ mthong lam mo// dang po gzhi shes kyi rang bzhin la bzhi ste/ ngo bo mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa/ mtshan mar 'dzin na ring ba/ thabs mkhas pa nye ba/ byed pa mi mthun phyogs dang mnyen po'o// dang po ngo bo mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa ni/ tshu rol pha rol mtha' la min// de dag bar na mi gnas pa// dus rnams mnyam pa nyid shes phyir// shes rab pha rol phyin par 'dod// ces so// gnyis pa mtshan mar 'dzin na ring ba ni/ de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas// thabs ma yin pa ring ba ste// gsum pa thabs mkhas pa nye ba ni/ de ni thabs la mkhas pa yis// yang dag nye ba nyid du bshad// ces so// bzhi pa byed pa mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po la bdun/ gzhi lam mtshan 'dzin spang bya dang/ de'i gnyen po dang/ 'bras bu la mtshan 'dzin spang byar bshad pa// gnyen po zab pa'i tshul/

bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ 'jug bsdu ba'o// dang po gzhi lam mtshan 'dzin spang byar bstan pa ni/ gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid dang// dus gsum gtogs pa'i chos rnams dang// sbyin sogs byang chub phyogs rnams la// spyod pa'i 'du shes mi mthun phyogs// zhes so// gnyis pa de'i gnyen po ni/ sbyin la sogs la ngar 'dzin med// gzhan dag de la sbyor byed pa// de ni chags pa'i mtha' 'gog pas// rgyal la sogs la chags pa phra// zhes so// gsum pa 'bras bu la mtshan 'dzin spang byar bshad pa ni/ chos kyi lam ni rang bzhin gyis// dben pa'i phyir na de zab nyid// ces so// bzhi pa gnyen po ni/ chos rnams rang bzhin gcig par ni// shes pas chags pa spong ba yin// ces so// lnga pa zab pa'i tshul ni/ mthong ba la sogs bkag pa yis// de ni rtogs par dka' bar bshad// ces so// drug pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni/ gzugs la sogs par mi shes phyir// de ni bsam mi khyab par 'dod// ces so/ bdun pa 'jug bsdu ba ni/ de ltar kun shes nyid lugs la// mi mthun gnyen po'i phyogs dag gi /rnam par dbye ba ma lus pa// ji skad bshad pa 'dir shes bya// ces so// sbyor ba'i lam la gnyis te/ rang bzhin dang gegs sel ba dang/ mnyam pa nyid bsgom pa'o// dang po rang bzhin ni/ gzugs sogs de mi rtag sogs dang// de ma rdzogs dang rab rdzogs dang// de la chags pa med nyid la// spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba dang// mi 'gyur byed po med nyid dang// bya dka' rnam gsum sbyor ba dang// skal ba ji bzhin 'bras thob pas// 'bras yod 'dod pa nyid dang ni// gzhan la rag las med gang dang// snang ba rnam bdun shes byed do// zhes so// gnyis pa mnyam pa nyid bsgom pa ni/ gzugs la sogs la rlom med pa// rnam bzhi de yi mnyam pa nyid// ces so// gsum pa mthong lam la gnyis ste/ ye shes skad cig ma mdor bstan dang/

rtogs pa rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po mdor bstan ni/ sdug bsngal la sogs bden pa la// chos shes rjes su shes pa dang// bzod shes skad cig bdag nyid 'di// kun shes tshul la mthong ba'i lam// ces so// rgyas par bshad pa ni/ gzugs rtag ma yin mi rtag min// mtha' las 'das dang rnam dag dang// ma skyes ma 'gags la sogs dang// mkha' 'dra chags pa spangs ba dang// yongs su 'dzin las grol ba dang// ngo bo nyid kyis brjod med dang// gang phyir 'di don brjod pa yis// gzhan la sbyin du med pa dang// dmigs pa med par byed pa dang// shin tu rnam dag nad mi 'byung// ngan song chad dang 'bras bu ni// mngon du bya la mi rtog nyid// mtshan ma dag dang ma 'brel dang// dngos dang ming dang gnyis po la// shes pa skye ba med pa ni// kun shes nyid kyi skad cig ma// zhes so// gnyis pa mkhyen pa gsum gyi bsdu ba ni/ de ltar 'di dang yang 'di dang// yang 'di yin te rnam gsum po// 'di ni gnas skabs gsum po dag /rdzogs par yongs su bstan pa yin// zhes so// skabs gsum pa'o/// /gnyis pa thabs sbyor ba bzhi la gnyis te/ dbang du byed pa rgyu 'bras dang/ brtan pa rgyu 'bras so// dang po dbang du byed pa rgyu 'bras la gnyis te/ dbang du byed pa'i rgyu rnam kun/ dbang gyur thob pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba'o// dang po dbang du byed pa'i rgyu rnam kun la gnyis te/ sbyor ba spyir bstan pa dang/ khyad par can no// dang po sbyor ba spyir bstan pa la bzhi/ sbyor ba'i yul rnam pa/ bsgom mkhan gang zag sbyor ba'i rab dbye/ sngon 'gro'i chos so// dang po sbyor ba'i yul rnam pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ gzhi shes pa yi bye brag rnams// rnam pa zhes bya mtshan nyid de/ kun mkhyen nyid ni rnam gsum phyir// de ni rnam pa gsum du 'dod// ces so// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum/

gzhi shes mdo bzhin bden bzhi la sbyar ba nyi shu rtsa bdun dang/ lam shes kyi rnam pa so drug bstan pa dang/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'o// dang po gzhi shes mdo bzhin bden bzhi la sbyar ba nyi shu rtsa bdun ni/ med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung ste// mi g.yo ba yi rnam pa'i bar// bden pa so so la bzhi dang// lam la de ni bco lngar bshad// ces so// gnyis pa lam shes kyi rnam pa so drug ni/ rgyu dang lam dang sdug bsngal dang// 'gog pa la ni go rim bzhin// de dag brgyad dang bdun dang ni// lnga dang bcu drug ces bsgrags so// zhes so// gsum pa/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa ni/ dran pa nyer bzhag nas bzung ste// sangs rgyas rnam pa'i mthar thug rnams// lam gyi bden pa'i rjes mthun par// kun mkhyen gsum du phye bas na// slob ma byang chub sems dpa' dang// sangs rgyas rnam la rim bzhin te// sum cu bdun dang sum bcu bzhi// sum cu rtsa dgu dag tu bzhed// ces so// gnyis pa bsgom mkhan gang zag ni/ sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas// de la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun// dge ba'i bshes kyi mgon bcas pa// 'di mnyan pa yi snod yin no// sangs rgyas bsten dang kun 'dri dang// sbyin dang tshul khrims sogs spyod pas// len dang 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i// snod du dam pa rnams bzhed do// ces so// gsum pa sbyor ba'i rab dbye ni/ gzugs la sogs la mi gnas phyir// de la sbyor ba bkag pa'i phyir// de yi de bzhin nyid zab phyir// de rnams gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir// de dag tshad ni med phyir dang// tshegs chen yun ring rtogs pa'i phyir// lung bstan phyir mi ldog nyid dang// nges 'byung bar chad med bcas dang// byang chub nye dang myur ba dang// gzhan don 'phel med 'grib med phyir// chos dang chos min sogs mi mthong// gzugs sogs bsam mi khyab mi mthong// gzugs sogs de yi mtshan ma dang// de yi ngo bo rnam mi rtog

/'bras bu rin chen sbyin byed dang// de ni dag pa 'tshams dang bcas// zhes so// bzhi pa/ sngon 'gro'i chos la bzhi/ sbyor ba'i yon tan/ sbyor ba'i skyon/ nus pa mtshan nyid/ thar pa cha mthun no// dang po yon tan ni/ bdud kyi mthu bcom la sogs pa/ yon tan rnam pa bcu bzhi 'o// zhes so// gnyis pa skyon ni/ skyon ni bcu tshan bzhir bcas pa// drug tu nges par rtogs par bya// zhes so// gsum pa nus pa mtshan nyid la gnyis/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad do// dang po// mdor bstan ni/ gang gis mtshon de mtshan nyid du// shes bya de yang rnam pa gsum// shes pa khyad par byed pa ste// ngo bo nyid gang mtshon bya yang// zhes so// rgyas bshad la drug /shes pa'i rnam pa'i bye brag bcu drug gis thams cad shes pa'i mtshan nyid/ shes rnam bcu drug gis lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ shes rnam bcu drug gis rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid/ khyad par bcu drug gi mtshan nyid/ byed pa'i mtshan nyid/ de'i ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid do// dang po shes pa'i bye brag bcu drug gis thams cad shes pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba dang// 'jig rten 'jig med bdag nyid dang/ sems can sems kyi spyod pa dang// de bsdus pa dang phyir ltas dang// mi zad pa yi rnam pa dang// chags bcas sogs dang rgya chen dang// chen por gyur dang tshad med dang// rnam shes bstan du med pa dang// sems bltar med dang shes pa de// g.yo ba la sogs zhes bya dang// de las gzhan yang de dag ni// de bzhin nyid kyi rnam par shes// thub pas de bzhin nyid rtogs de// gzhan la bstan pa zhes bya 'di// thams cad shes pa nyid skabs kyi// shes pa'i mtshan nyid bsdus pa yin// ces so// gnyis pa shes rnam bcu drug gis lam shes kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa ni/ stong nyid mtshan ma med bcas dang// smon pa rnam par spangs pa dang// skye med 'gag pa med sogs dang// chos nyid rnam par 'khrug med dang// 'du mi byed dang rnam mi rtog

/rab dbye mtshan nyid med nyid la// lam shes nyid kyi skabs kyis ni// shes pa'i mtshan nyid yin par bzhed// ces so// gsum pa shes rnam bcu drug gis rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid bstan pa ni/ de ni nyid kyi chos brten nas// gnas dang gus par bya ba dang// bla ma nyid dang mnyes pa dang// de la mchod dang byed med dang// kun tu 'jug mkhyen gang yin dang// ma mthong ston par mdzad pa dang// 'jig rten stong nyid rnam pa dang// brjod dang shes mdzad mngon sum mdzad// bsam mi khyab dang zhi nyid ston// 'jig rten 'du shes 'gog pa la// rnam pa kun mkhyen tshul la ni// shes pa'i mtshan nyid ces bshad do// zhes so// bzhi pa khyad par gyi mtshan nyid bcu drug bstan pa la/ mdor bstan dang/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ bsam mi khyab sogs khyad par gyis// khyad zhugs bden pa'i spyod yul can// skad cig ma ni bcu drug gis// khyad par mtshan nyid bshad pa yin// ces so// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa ni/ bsam mi khyab dang mi mnyam dang// gzhal dang bgrang las yang dag 'das// 'phags pa kun sdud mkhas pa yis// rig bya thun mong min shes nyid// shes myur bri dang gang med dang// sgrub dang yang dag 'grub pa dang// dmigs pa rten dang bcas pa dang// mtha' dag pa dang yongs 'dzin dang// ro myang med dang khyad par ni// bcu drug bdag nyid shes bya ste// gang gis lam ni gzhan dag las// khyad du 'phags pas khyad par lam// ces so// lnga pa byed pa'i mtshan nyid ni// phan dang bde dang skyob pa dang// mi rnams kyis ni skyabs dag dang// gnas dang dpung gnyen gling dang ni// yongs 'dren pa zhes bya ba dang// lhun gyis grub dang theg gsum gyi// 'bras bu mngon sum mi byed bdag /tha ma rten gyi mdzad pa ste// 'di ni byed pa'i mtshan nyid yin// ces so// drug pa de'i ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid ni/

nyon mongs rtags dang mtshan ma dang// mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po dag /dben dang dka' dang nges pa dang// ched du bya dang mi dmigs dang// mngon par zhen pa bkag pa dang// dmigs pa zhes bya gang yin dang// mi mthun thogs pa med dang de// gzhi med 'gro med skye med dang// de bzhin nyid ni mi dmigs dang// ngo bo nyid bcu drug bdag nyid// mtshon bya lta bur mtshon pas na// mtshan nyid bzhi par bzhed pa yin// zhes so// bzhi pa thar pa cha mthun la gnyis mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad do// dang po mdor bstan ni/ mtshan med rab tu sbyin la sogs// yang dag sgrub la mkhas pa ni// rnam pa thams cad rtogs 'di la// thar pa'i cha dang mthun par 'dod// ces so// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa ni/ sangs rgyas sogs dmigs dad pa dang// sbyin sogs spyod yul brtson 'grus dang// bsam pa phun tshogs dran pa dang// rnam par mi rtog ting 'dzin dang// chos rnams rnam pa thams cad du// shes pa'i shes rab dang rnam lnga// rdzogs pa'i byang chub rnon po yis// rtogs sla rtul pos rtogs dkar bzhed// ces so// gnyis pa khyad par can la gsum/ drod rtse bzod pa chos mchog gi bsgom pa'i gnas skabs/ gang zag bsgom rim khyad par can no// dang po drod rtse bzod pa chos mchog gi bsgom pa'i gnas skabs ni/ dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir// sems can thams cad yin par bsngags// de dag nyid la sems mnyam sogs// rnam pa dag ni bcur bshad do// bdag nyid sdig pa las ldog cing// sbyin la sogs la gnas pas gzhan// de dag la ni 'god pa dang// bsngags pa brjod dang mthun pa nyid// rtser gyur de bzhin bzod pa ni// rang gzhan rten can bden shes pa// chos mchog de bzhin sems can rnams// smin byed sogs kyis shes par bya// zhes so// gnyis pa gang zag la bzhi/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun mdor bstan/ sbyor lam gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags nyi shu/

mthong lam gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags bcu drug /bsgom lam gyi rtags so// dang po phyi mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun mdor bstan pa ni/ nges 'byed yan lag nas bzung ste// mthong dang goms pa'i lam dag la// byang chub sems dpa' gang dag gnas// de 'dir phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs// zhes so// gnyis pa sbyor lam gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags nyi shu bstan pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad do// dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ gzugs la sogs las ldog sogs rtags// rnam pa nyi shur brjod pa yis// nges 'byed yan lag la gnas pa'i// phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid 'di// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa ni/ gzugs la sogs las ldog pa dang// the tshom mi dal zad pa dang// bdag nyid dge ba la gnas shing// gzhan dag de la 'god pa dang/ gzhan gyi rten can sbyin sogs dang// zab mo'i don la'ang som nyi med// byams lus sogs dang sgrib pa ni/ rnam pa lnga dang mi 'grogs dang// bag la nyal kun 'joms pa dang// dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dang// gos la sogs pa gtsang ba dang/ lus la srin bu rnams mi 'byung// gya gyu med sems sbyangs pa ni// len dang ser sna med sogs dang// chos nyid ldan par 'gro nyid dang// sems can don du dmyal tshol dang// gzhan gyis bkri bar mi btub dang// lam gzhan nye bar ston bdud la// bdud ces bya bar rtogs pa dang// sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i spyod pa ste// rtags ni nyi shu de dag gis// drod dang rtse mo bzod bcas dang// chos mchog rnams la gnas pa ni// rdzogs pa'i byang chub las mi ldog /ces so// gsum pa mthong lam gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags bcu drug la gnyis/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad do// dang po mdor bstan ni/ mthong ba'i lam la bzod pa dang// shes pa'i skad cig bcu drug ni// byang chub sems dpa' mi ldog pa'i// mtshan nyid yin par shes par bya// zhes so// gnyis pa rgyas bshad ni/

gzugs sogs 'du shes ldog pa dang// sems brtan theg pa dman dag las// rnam log bsam gtan la sogs pa'i// yan lag yongs su zad pa dang// lus sems yang ba nyid dang ni// 'dod la spyod la thabs mkhas dang// rtag tu tshangs par spyod nyid dang// 'tsho ba rnam par dag nyid dang// phung sogs bar chad byed rnams dang// tshogs dang dbang sogs bcas pa yi// g.yul 'gyed ser sna la sogs la// sbyor dang rjes su sbyor ba yi// gnas pa so sor bkag pa dang// chos ni rdul tsam mi dmigs nyid// rang gi sa la nges pa nyid// sa gsum la ni gnas pa dang// chos kyi don du srog gtong ba// de 'dra'i skad cig bcu drug ni// blo ldan mthong ba'i lam gnas kyi// phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dag yin// zhes so// bzhi pa bsgom lam gyi rtags la brgyad de/ bsgom lam gyi khyad par/ khyad par gyi gzhi/ dbye ba/ grangs med pa bstan pa mi 'ga' ba/ bsgom lam gyi byed pa/ 'bras bu la rtsod pa dgod pa/ lan dpe dang bcas pa/ zab mo brgyad kyis rtags nyid bstan pa'o// dang po bsgom lam gyi khyad par bstan pa ni/ bsgom pa'i lam ni zab pa ste// zab mo stong pa nyid la sogs// zab pa de ni sgro 'dogs dang// skur pa'i mtha' las grol ba nyid// ces so// gnyis pa khyad gzhi bstan pa ni/ nges 'byed yan lag dang mthong ba'i// lam dang bsgom pa'i lam nyid la// yang dang yang du sems pa dang// 'jal dang nges rtog bsgom pa'i lam// zhes so// gsum pa dbye ba ni/ de ni rgyun chags yin pa phyir// chung dang 'bring dang chen po rnams// chung ngu'i chung sogs dbye ba yis// rnam pas rnam pa dgur bzhed do// zhes so// bzhi pa grangs med pa bstan pa mi 'gal ba ni/ grangs med la sogs bstan pa rnams// dam pa'i don du bzod ma yin// kun rdzob tu ni thugs brtse ba'i// rgyu mthun de dag thub pa bzhed// ces so// lnga pa bsgom lam gyi byed pa la/

brgal ba dang/ lan gnyis/ dang po brgal ba ni/ dngos po brjod du med pa la// nyams pa dang ni 'phel mi rung// sgom zhes bya ba'i lam gyis ni// ci zhig nyams shing ci zhig 'thob// ces so// gnyis pa lan ni/ byang chub ji lta de bzhin du// 'di ni 'dod pa'i don sgrub byed// byang chub de bzhin nyid mtshan nyid// de yang de yi mtshan nyid bzhed// ces so// drug pa 'bras bu la rtsod pa dgod pa ni/ sems ni snga mas byang chub par// rigs min phyi mas kyang ma yin// ces so// gnyis pa lan dpe dang bcas pa ni/ mar me'i dpe yi tshul gyis ni// zab mo'i chos nyid rnam pa brgyad// ces so// brgyad pa zab mo brgyad kyi rtags nyid bstan pa ni/ skye ba dang ni 'gag pa dang// de bzhin nyid dang shes bya dang// shes dang spyod dang gnyis med dang// thabs mkhas pa la zab pa nyid// ces so// gsum pa bsgom rim khyad par can la gsum/ srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba/ zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba/ thabs mkhas pa'i sbyor ba bcu bsgom pa'o// dang po srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba ni/ chos rnams rmi lam 'dra ba'i phyir// srid dang zhi bar mi rtog pa// las med la sogs klan ka yi// lan ni ji skad bshad par zad// ces so// gnyis pa zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba ni/ sems can 'jig rten de bzhin du// snod kyi 'jig rten ma dag pa// de la dag par bsgrub pa yis// sangs rgyas zhing ni dag pa nyid// ces so// gsum pa thabs mkhas pa'i sbyor ba ni// yul dang sbyor ba can 'di ni// dgra rnams las ni 'das pa dang// mi gnas ji bzhin shugs dang ni// thun mong ma yin mtshan nyid dang// ma chags pa dang mi dmigs dang// mtshan ma smon lam zad pa dang// de yi rtags dang tshad med pa// thabs la mkhas pa rnam pa bcu// zhes so// skabs bzhi pa'o/// /gnyis pa dbang gyur thob pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba la gnyis/ gnyen po rtse mo/

spang bya log sgrub bo// dang po gnyen po rtse mo la bzhi/ sbyor lam/ mthong lam/ bsgom lam/ bar chad med lam rtse mo'o// dang po sbyor lam la bzhi/ drod kyi rtse mo rtags kyis mtshon pa/ rtse mo'i rtse mo rnams par 'phel ba/ bzod pa'i rtse mo brtan pa/ chos mchog gi rtse mo sems kun tu gnas pa'o// dang po drod kyi rtse sbyor rtags kyis mtshon pa ni/ rmi lam na yang chos rnams kun// rmi lam lta bur lta la sogs// rtse mor phyin pa'i sbyor ba'i rtags// rnam pa bcu gnyis dag tu bzhed// ces so// gnyis pa rtse mo'i rtse mo rnam par 'phel ba ni/ 'dzam bu gling gi skye bo snyed// sangs rgyas mchod pa'i dge la sogs// rnam mang du ni dper mdzad nas// rnam 'phel bcu drug bdag nyid do// zhes so// gsum pa bzod pa'i rtse mo brtan pa ni/ kun mkhyen nyid gsum chos rnams kyi// yongs su rdzogs pa bla med pa// sems can don yongs mi gtong ba// brtan pa zhes ni mngon par brjod// ces so// bzhi pa chos mchog gi rtse sems kun tu gnas pa ni/ gling bzhi pa dang stong dag dang// stong gnyis gsum dag dper mdzad nas// bsod nams mang po nyid kyi ni// ting 'dzin yongs su bsgrags pa yin// zhes so// gnyis pa mthong lam rtse mo la drug spang bya rnam rtog /skye ba'i rgyu grogs/ 'bras bu byang chub/ rtse mo'i byed pa/ ngo bo/ de'i bsgom pa'o// dang po rnam rtog la bzhi ste/ gzung rtog mdor bstan/ 'dzin rtog mdor bstan/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i nges pa/ rgyas bshad do// dang po gzung rtog mdor bstan pa ni/ 'jug pa dang ni ldog pa la// gzung ba'i rnam rtog so sor de// dgu yi bdag nyid ji bzhin yul// min pa'i bdag nyid dag shes bya// zhes so// gnyis pa 'dzin rtog mdor bstan ni/ so so skye bo 'phags dbye bas// sems can rdzas dang btags yod par// rnam rtog 'dzin pa dag tu 'dod// de dag so sor dgu bdag nyid// zhes so// gsum pa gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i nges pa ni/

gal te gzung don de bzhin med// de dag gang gi 'dzin par 'dod// de ltar de dag 'dzin pa yi// ngo bos stong pa'i mtshan nyid do// zhes so// bzhi pa rgyas par bshad pa la bzhi/ 'jug pa'i gzung rtog dgu/ ldog pa'i gzung rtog dgu/ skyes bu rdzas 'dzin gyi rtog pa dgu/ btags 'dzin gyi rtog pa dgu'o// dang po 'jug pa'i gzung rtog dgu ni/ ngo bo nyid dang rigs dang ni// lam ni yang dag 'grub pa dang// shes pa'i dmigs pa ma 'khrul dang// mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po dang// rang gis rtogs dang byed pa dang// de yi las bya'i 'bras bu la// 'jug pa'i phyogs kyi rten can gyi// rnam rtog de ni rnam dgur 'dod// ces so// gnyis pa ldog pa'i gzung rtog dgu ni/ srid dang zhi bar ltung ba'i phyir// rtogs pa dman pa nyid dang ni// yongs su 'dzin pa med pa dang// lam gyi rnam pa ma tshang dang// gzhan gyi rkyen gyis 'gro ba dang// ched du bya ba log pa dang// nyi tshe ba dang sna tshogs nyid// gnas dang 'jug la rmongs pa dang// rjes la 'gro zhes bya ba la// rnam rtog dgu yi bdag nyid 'di// ldog pa'i phyogs kyi rten can te// nyan thos la sogs yid las 'byung// zhes so// gsum pa skyes bu rdzas 'dzin gyi rtog pa dgu ni/ 'dzin pa dang ni 'dor ba dang// yid la byed dang khams rnams ni// gsum po dag dang nyer 'brel dang// gnas dang mngon par zhen pa dang// chos kyis dngos po btags pa dang// chags pa dang ni gnyen po dang// ji ltar 'dod bzhin 'gro nyams la// 'dzin pa dang por shes par bya// zhes so// bzhi pa skyes bu btags 'dzin gyi rtog pa dgu ni/ ched bzhin nges par mi 'byung dang// lam la lam min nges 'dzin dang// 'gag dang bcas pa'i skye ba dang// dngos po ldan dang mi ldan dang// gnas dang rigs ni 'jig pa dang// don du gnyer dang rgyu med dang// phyir rgol ba ni dmigs pa la// 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gzhan yin no// zhes so// gnyis pa skye ba'i rgyu grogs ni/

byang chub la gzhan ston pa dang// de yi rgyu ni yongs gtod dang// de thob bar chad med pa'i rgyu// bsod nams mang po'i mtshan nyid do// zhes so// gsum pa 'bras bu byang chub chen po ni/ dri ma zad dang mi skye ba'i// ye shes byang chub ces brjod de// zad med skye med phyir de dag /go rim bzhin du shes par bya// 'gog pa med pa'i rang bzhin la// mthong zhes bya ba'i lam gyi ni// rnam par rtog rigs ci zhig zad// skye med rnam pa ci zhig 'thob// gzhan gyi chos rnams kyang yod la// shes bya la yang ston pa yi// sgrib pa zad par brjod pa gang// de la kho bos mtshar du brtsis// zhes so/ bzhi pa rtse mo'i byed pa ni/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag lta// yang dag mthong nas rnam par grol// zhes so// lnga pa mthong lam rtse sbyor ngo bo ni/ sbyin pa la sogs re rer ni// de dag phan tshun bsdus pa gang// skad cig gcig pa'i bzod pa yis// bsdus pa de 'dir mthong ba'i lam// zhes so// drug pa de'i bsgom pa ni/ de nas seng ge rnam bsgyings pa'i// ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas// rten cing 'brel 'byung lugs mthun dang// lugs mi mthun la rtog par byed// ces so// gsum pa bsgom lam la gsum ste/ rten sgom pa'i lam/ spang bya rnam rtog /rten pa yon tan no// dang po rten sgom pa'i lam ni/ 'gog dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgur// rnam pa gnyis su song 'ongs nas// 'dod par gtogs pa'i rnam par shes// mnyam bzhag min pa'i mtshams bzung ste// thod rgal du ni snyoms 'jug pa// gcig dang gnyis gsum bzhi dang lnga// drug dang bdun dang brgyad rgal nas// 'gog pa'i bar du mi 'drar 'gro// zhes so// gnyis pa spang bya rnams rtog la gnyis te/ gzung rtog dang/ 'dzin rtog go dang po gzung rtog la gnyis ste/

'jug pa gzung rtog dang/ ldog pa gzung rtog go /dang po 'jug pa gzung rtog ni/ mdor bsdus rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyis// btang bas yongs su ma bzung dang// dus gsum yon tan med pa dang// legs pa'i lam ni rnam gsum la// gzung ba'i rnam rtog 'di gcig ste// sbyor ba'i rnam pa'i spyod yul can// zhes so// gnyis pa ldog pa gzung rtog ni/ gnyis pa sems dang sems byung rnams// 'jug pa'i yul can yin bzhed de// sems mi skye dang byang chub kyi// snying po yid la mi byed dang// theg pa dman pa yid byed dang// rdzogs pa'i byang chub yid mi byed// sgom dang sgom pa med pa dang// de dag las ni bzlog nyid dang// ji bzhin don min rnam rtog pa// sgom pa'i lam la shes par bya// zhes so// gnyis pa 'dzin rtog la gnyis te/ sbyor ba'i yul can gyi 'dzin rtog dgu/ 'jug pa'i yul can gyi 'dzin rtog dgu'o// dang po sbyor ba'i yul can gyi 'dzin rtog dgu ni/ sems can btags pa'i spyod yul dang// chos btags pa dang stong min nyid// chags dang rab 'byed bdag nyid dang// dngos por byed dang theg gsum dang// yon ni dag pa ma yin dang// spyod pa rnam par 'khrugs pa la// 'dzin par byed pa dang por de// shes par bya ba bsgrags pa yin// zhes so// gnyis pa 'jug pa'i yul can gyi 'dzin rtog dgu la gnyis/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad do// dang po mdor bstan ni/ sems can btags dang de rgyu yi// yul can de yis rnam 'joms pas// sgom pa'i lam dang 'brel pa yi// mi mthun phyogs gzhan rnam pa dgu// zhes so// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa ni/ bdag nyid ji bzhin kun mkhyen ni// gsum gyi sgrib pa rnam gsum dang// zhi lam de bzhin nyid sogs dang// mtshungs par ldan dang mi ldan dang// mi mnyam sdug bsngal la sogs dang// nyon mongs rnams kyi rang bzhin dang// gnyis su med la kun rmongs la// rnam par rtog pa tha mar bzhed// ces so// gsum pa rten pa yon tan ni/

yams nad 'di rnams zad nas ni// yun rings lon nas dbugs phyin ltar// rnam pa kun tu 'gro ba yi// bde sgrub yon tan phun tshogs kun// rgya mtsho che la chu bo bzhin// 'bras bu mchog gis spa ba yi// sems dpa' chen po de la ni// rnam pa kun tu rten par byed// ces so// bzhi pa bar chad med pa rtse mo la gsum/ dpe dang/ rang ldog ngos bzung ba dang/ dmigs pa bdag po rnam pa bstan pa'o// dang po dpe ni/ stong gsum skye bo nyan thos dang// bse ru'i rtogs pa phun tshogs dang// byang chub sems dpa'i skyon med la// bkod pa'i dge ba dper mdzad nas// bsod nams mang po nyid kyis ni// sangs rgyas nyid kyi bar med do// gnyis pa rang ldog ngos bzung ba ni/ bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni// de ni rnam pa kun mkhyen nyid// ces so/ gsum pa dmigs pa bdag po rnam pa bstan pa ni/ 'di yi dmigs pa dngos med do// bdag po dran pa yin par bzhed// rnam pa zhi nyid// ces so// gnyis pa spang bya log bsgrub la gnyis te/ bstan pa dang/ bshad pa'o// dang po bstan pa ni/ 'di la ni/ rab tu smra rnams rgyud mar rgol// zhes so// gnyis pa bshad pa ni/ dmigs pa 'thad dang de yi ni// ngo bo nyid nges gzung ba dang// rnam kun mkhyen nyid ye shes dang/ dam pa'i don dang kun rdzob dang// sbyor dang dkon mchog gsum po dang// thabs bcas thub pa'i rtogs pa dang// phyin ci log ni lam bcas dang// gnyen po mi mthun phyogs dag dang// mtshan nyid dang ni sgom pa la// smra ba rnams kyi log rtogs pa// rnam pa kun mkhyen nyid rten can// rnam pa bcu drug dag tu bzhed// ces so/ skabs lnga pa'o/// /gnyis pa brtan pa rgyu 'bras la gnyis te/ rgyu mthar gyis pa dang/ 'bras bu skad cig ma'o// dang po rgyu mthar gyis pa la gnyis te/ lam gang la brten nas/ gang bsgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ sbyin pa shes rab bar dag dang// sangs rgyas la sogs dran dang chos/

dngos med ngo bo nyid kyis de// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ mthar gyis pa yi bya bar bzhed// ces so// skabs drug pa'o/// /gnyis pa 'bras bu skad cig ma la bzhi ste/ rnam par smin pa ma yin pa dang/ rnam par smin pa dang/ mtshan nyid med pa dang/ gnyis su med pa'i skad cig ma'o// dang po rnam smin ma yin pa'i skad cig ma la gnyis te/ don dgod pa dang/ de nyid dpes sgrub pa'o// dang po don dgod pa ni/ sbyin pa la sogs re res kyang// zag med chos kun bsdus pa'i phyir// thub pa'i skad cig gcig pa yi// rtogs pa 'di ni shes par bya// zhes so// gnyis pa de nyid dpes bsgrub pa ni/ ji ltar skyes bus zo chun rgyud// rdog thabs gcig gis bskyed pa na// thams cad gcig char 'gul ba ltar// skad cig cig shes de bzhin no// zhes so// gnyis pa rnam par smin pa'i skad cig ma ni/ gang tshe chos dkar thams cad kyi// rang bzhin shes rab pha rol phyin// rnam smin chos nyid gnas skabs skyes// de tshe skad cig gcig ye shes// zhes so// gsum pa mtshan nyid med pa'i skad cig ma ni/ sbyin pa la sogs spyod pa yis// chos kun rmi lam 'drar gnas nas// chos rnams mtshan nyid med pa nyid// skad cig ma ni gcig gis rtogs// zhes so// bzhi pa gnyis su med pa'i skad cig ma ni/ rmi lam dang ni de mthong nyid// gnyis kyi tshul du mi mthong ltar// chos rnams gnyis su med pa yi// de nyid skad cig gcig gis mthong// zhes so// skabs bdun pa'o/// /gsum pa 'bras bu chos sku la lnga ste/ ngo bo nyid/ chos dang/ longs spyod rdzogs pa dang/ sprul pa'i sku dang/ chos sku'i mdzad pa'o// dang po ngo bo nyid kyi sku ni/ thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni// zag pa med pa'i chos gang dag /thob gyur rnam kun rnam dag pa// de dag rang bzhin mtshan nyid can// zhes so// gnyis pa chos sku la drug

/chos rnams kyi rnam pa bshad pa/ nyan thos kyi nyon mongs pa med pa las khyad par/ smon nas mkhyen pa'i khyad par/ phrin las 'jug pa'i tshul/ ma nges pa spang ba/ khyab pa dang rtag pa'i don no// dang po chos rnams kyi rnam pa bshad pa ni/ byang chub phyogs mthun tshad med dang// rnam par thar dang mthar gyis ni// snyoms 'jug dgu yi bdag nyid dang// zad par bcu yi bdag nyid dang// zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched ni// rab tu dbye bas rnam brgyad dang// nyon mongs med dang smon mkhyen dang// mngon shes so so yang dag rig /rnam pa thams cad dag bzhi dang// dbang bcu dang ni stobs bcu dang// mi 'jigs pa ni bzhi dbang dang// bsrung ba med pa rnam gsum dang/ dran pa nyer bzhag rnam gsum dang// bsnyel ba mi mnga'i chos nyid dang// bag chags yang dag bcom pa dang// skye la thugs rje chen po dang// thub pa kho na'i ma 'dres chos// bco brgyad bshad pa gang yin dang// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid dang// chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin// zhes so// gnyis pa nyan thos kyi nyon mongs pa med pa las khyad par bstan pa ni/ nyan thos nyon mongs med pa'i lta// mi yi nyon mongs yongs spong nyid// grong sogs su de'i nyon mongs rnams// rgyun gcod rgyal ba'i nyon mongs med// ces so// smon nas mkhyen pa'i khyad par ni/ sangs rgyas smon nas mkhyen pa ni// lhun gyis grub dang chags spangs dang// thogs pa med dang rtag gnas dang// 'dri ba kun lan 'debs par bzhed// ces so// bzhi pa phrin las 'jug pa'i tshul ni/ rgyu ni yongs su smin gyur nas// gang dang gang la gang dang ni// gang tshe bya ba phan gyur pa// de dang de la de snang ngo// zhes so// lnga pa ma nges pa spang ba ni/ lha yi rgyal pos char phab kyang// sa bon mi rung mi 'khrungs ltar// sangs rgyas rnams ni byung gyur kyang// skal ba med pas bzang mi myong// zhes so// drug pa khyab pa dang rtag pa'i don ni/

de ltar mdzad pa rgya che'i phyir// sangs rgyas khyab par nges par brjod// de nyid zad pa med pa'i phyir// rtag pa zhes kyang brjod pa yin// zhes so// gsum pa longs sku la lnga ste/ mdor bstan pa/ mtshan bzang po bshad pa/ ji ltar 'grub pa/ rgyu mdo la sbyar ba/ dpe byad bshad pa'o// dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ mtshan ni sum bcu rtsa gnyis dang// dpe byad brgyad bcu'i bdag nyid 'di// theg chen nye bar longs spyod phyir/ thub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhed// ces so// gnyis pa mtshan bzang po bshad pa ni/ phyag zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan dang rus sbal zhabs/ phyag dang zhabs sor dra bas 'brel ba dang// phyag ni zhabs bcas 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags// 'di yi sku ni bdun dag mtho ba dang// sor mo ring dang rting yangs sku che drang// zhabs 'bur mi mngon spu ni gyen du phyogs// byin pa e na ya'i 'dra phyag ring mdzes// 'doms kyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa'i mchog /lpags pa gser mdog lpags pa srab pa dang// spu ni re re nas g.yas legs 'khrungs dang// zhal mdzod spus brgyan ro stod seng ge'i 'dra// 'di yi dpung pa'i mgo zlum thal god rgyas// 'di la ro mi zhim pa ro mchog snang// sku ni n+ya gro ta ltar chu zheng gab// gtsug tor dbur ldan ljags ring mdzes pa dang// tshangs dbyangs 'gram pa seng ge'i 'dra dang tshems// shin tu dkar dang tshad mnyam thag bzang dang// grangs ni bzhi bcu tham pa tshang ba dang// spyan ni mthon mthing spyan rdzi ba mchog gi /'dra ba 'di dag sum bcu rtsa gnyis mtshan// zhes so// gsum pa ji ltar 'grub pa ni/ 'di la mtshan ni gang gang gi /sgrub par byed pa'i rgyu gang yin// de dang de ni rab rdzogs pas// mtshan ni 'di dag yang dag 'grub// ces so/ bzhi pa rgyu mdo la sbyar ba ni/ bla ma skyel la sogs pa dang// yang dag blangs pa brtan pa dang// bsdu ba bsten dang gya nom pa'i// dngos po sbyin dang gsad bya ba// thar bar byed dang dge ba ni/

yang dag blangs ba spel la sogs// sgrub byed rgyu yi mtshan nyid de// mdo las ji skad 'byung ba bzhin// zhes so// lnga pa dpe byad bshad pa ni/ thub pa'i sen mo zangs mdog dang// mdog snum mtho dang sor mo rnams// zlum rgyas byin gyis phra ba dang// rtsa mi mngon dang mdun pa med// long bu mi mngon zhabs mnyam dang/ seng ge glang chen bya dang ni// khyu mchog stabs gshegs g.yas phyogs dang// mdzes shes brang dang 'khril bag chags// byi dor byas 'dra rim par 'tshams// gtsang dang 'jam dang dag pa'i sku// mtshan ni yongs su rdzogs pa dang// sku yi kho lag yangs shing bzang// gom snyoms pa dang spyan gnyis ni// dag dang gzhon sha can nyid dang// sku zhum med dang rgyas pa dang// shin du grim pa'i sku nyid dang// yan lag shin du rnam 'byed dang// gzigs pa sgrib med dag pa dang// sku zlum skabs phyin ma rnyongs dang// phyang nge ba dang lte ba ni// zab dang g.yas phyogs 'khyil ba dang// kun nas lta na sdug pa dang// kun spyod gtsang dang sku la ni// sme ba gnag bag med pa dang// phyag ni shing bal ltar 'jam dang// phyag ris mdangs yod zab ring dang// zhal ni ha cang mi ring dang// mchu ni bim pa ltar dmar dang// ljags mnyen pa dang srab pa dang// dmar dang 'brug gi sgra nyid dang// gsung mnyen 'jam dang mche ba zlum// rno dang dkar dang mnyam pa dang/ byin gyis phra dang shangs mtho dang// mchog tu dag pa dag dang ni// spyan yangs pa dang rdzi ma stug /pad+ma'i 'dab ma 'dra ba dang// smin tshugs ring dang 'jam pa dang// snum dang spu ni 'jam pa dang// phyag ring rgyas dang snyan mnyam dang// nyams pa rnam par spangs ba dang// dpral ba legs par 'byed pa dang// dbyes che ba dang dbu rgyas dang// dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag dang// stugs dang 'jam dang ma 'dzings dang// mi bshor dri zhim skyes bu yi// yid ni 'phrog par byed pa dang// dpal gyi be'u dang bkra shis ni// sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang por bzhed// bzhi pa sprul sku la gsum/

dus dang/ gang gi don dang/ rgyun mi 'chad pa'i tshul lo// dang po dus ni/ gang gis srid pa ji srid par// zhes so// gnyis pa gang gi don mdzad pa ni/ 'gro la phan pa sna tshogs dag /mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku de ni// ces so// gsum pa rgyun mi 'chad pa'i tshul ni/ thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi 'chad// ces so// lnga pa chos sku'i mdzad pa ni gsum/ 'jug yul rgyun mi 'chad pa/ phrin las nyi shu rtsa bdun bshad pa/ don bsdu ba'o// dang po 'jug yul rgyun mi 'chad pa ni/ de bzhin 'khor ba ji srid 'di'i// las ni rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod// ces so// gnyis pa phrin las nyi shu rtsa bdun bshad pa ni/ 'gro rnams zhi ba'i las dang ni// bsdu rnam bzhi la dgod pa dang// kun nas nyon mongs bcas pa yi// rnam par byang ba rtogs pa dang// sems can rnams don ji bzhin gyi// don dang pha rol phyin drug dang// sangs rgyas lam dang rang bzhin gyis// stong pa nyid dang gnyis zad dang// brda dang dmigs pa med pa dang// lus can rnams ni yongs smin dang// byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang ni// mngon par zhen pa bzlog pa dang// byang chub thob dang sangs rgyas zhing// rnam par dag dang nges pa dang/ sems can don ni tshad med dang// sangs rgyas bsten sogs yon tan dang// byang chub yan lag las rnams ni// chud mi za dang bden mthong dang// phyin ci log ni spangs pa dang// de gzhi med pa'i tshul dang ni/ rnam par byang dang tshogs dang ni// 'dus byas 'dus ma byas pa la// tha dad yongs su mi shes dang// mya ngan 'das la dgod pa ste// chos kyi sku yi phrin las ni/ rnam pa nyi shu bdun du bzhed/ ces so/ skabs brgyad pa'o/// /gsum pa mjug gi don/ bsdus don rnam grangs gzhan bstan pa la gnyis/ drug tu bshad pa/ gsum du bsdu ba'o// dang po drug tu bshad pa ni// mtshan nyid de yi sbyor ba dang// de rab de yi go rim dang// de mtha' de yi rnam smin ni// don bsdus gzhan te rnam pa drug

/ces so// gnyis pa gsum du bsdu ba ni/ yul ni rnam pa gsum po rgyu// sbyor ba bzhi yi bdag nyid dang// chos sku phrin las 'bras bu ni// don bsdus gzhan te rnam pa gsum// ces so// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces bya ba/ rje btsun byams pa mgon pos mdzad pa/ rdzogs so// rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi r+ya ka ra pra bha dang/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// slad kyis rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal go mi 'chi med la sogs pa dang/ lots+tsha ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// rgyal yum pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung rnams kun// rgyal sras ma pham pa yis brgyan byas pa// rgyal ba'i mdo bzhin mkhas grub rnams kyis phye// bod 'dir snga rabs 'das pa'i mkhas rnams kyis// blo gros ldan pa'i rgyas bsdus du ma byas// phyi dus tshig nyung rnam bshad mang byas pas// bdag gi don bsdus dgos med ma yin nam// 'on kyang lung tsam dge ba'i bshes las thos// phyi dus lha steng dben pa byed pa'i tshe// rab rib 'khrul pa'i gnyid kyi rmi lam na// steng phyogs mnyam pa sa yi dbus na ni// khang brtsegs mdzes na rgyal ba'i mchod rten drung// dge ba'i bshes bzhugs gsum gyi mgrin gcig tu// pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung 'di gsungs pa thos// sad tshe blo la rab tu gsal bar snang// de phyir 'di la mos pa rgya chen skyes// rnam bshad byas kyang 'jug par byed med pas// mngon rtogs snang byed don bsdus tshig 'di dang// skabs brgyad stong thun gnyis
karma pa rang byung rdo rjes sbyar dge ba yis// myur du rgyal yum mngon du ston par shog //
